summary: Iter48 (Push Notification Settings · opt-out/opt-in) backend testing — 18/18 NEW iter48 tests PASS plus full smoke regression. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter48_push_settings.py covering: (a) GET /api/push-status across 4 states — never (no doc → state='never', enabled=False, platform=null), registered/pending_deploy (after register-push → enabled=True, platform reflected), disabled (after disable-push → state='disabled', enabled=False, platform preserved from prior register); (b) 422 validation — missing query param, empty user_id; (c) POST /api/disable-push happy path updates {notifications_enabled:false, disabled_at, updated_at}; (d) disable-push on never-registered user creates SHELL doc (notifications_enabled:false, status:'disabled', platform:null, created_at) — no crash, status endpoint reports 'disabled'; (e) 422 on empty/missing user_id; (f) Idempotency: 2 consecutive disable-push → 2x 200 same payload, 1 doc, still notifications_enabled=False; (g) End-to-end lifecycle: register → status registered/pending → disable → status disabled → re-register → status registered/pending + notifications_enabled=True + disabled_at $unset; (h) CRITICAL push_service.send_push() opt-out filter via httpx mock — verified via monkeypatched _get_client(): when payload mixes enabled+disabled user_ids, disabled IDs are STRIPPED from upstream `recipients`; when ALL recipients are disabled, send_push returns False AND zero upstream calls (await_count==0); when all are enabled, full list survives; (i) Regression smoke: GET /api/ 200, admin login 200 with access_token, GET /api/public/retas/buscar 200 list, GET /.well-known/apple-app-site-association 200 application/json with applinks. Iter45 regression: 16/16 PASS. Iter47 regression: 17 PASS + 2 SKIP (infra-flagged .well-known via public ingress, unchanged from iter47). Iter46 regression: 12/17 (same 5 pre-existing motor event-loop ERRORs flagged in iter47 report — NOT a regression introduced by iter48, which only adds GET /push-status, POST /disable-push, and the opt-out filter inside push_service.send_push()).

action_items: (No fixes needed for iter48) — All new endpoints behave as specified: GET /api/push-status (4 states), POST /api/disable-push (idempotent + shell-doc + 422 validation), push_service.send_push() opt-out filter (excludes notifications_enabled=False from upstream payload AND skips call entirely when all disabled).

(Optional, pre-existing carry-over from iter47) Fix motor fixture event-loop flake in test_iter46_acid_refund_overflow.py — replace `asyncio.get_event_loop()` pattern with session-scoped pytest-asyncio loop or new_event_loop()+set_event_loop() inside fixture body. Not blocking iter48.
critical_code_review_comments: push_router.py is well-structured: GET /push-status correctly derives state from {notifications_enabled, status} with disabled taking priority over raw status; POST /disable-push uses $set on existing docs and inserts a SHELL doc when matched_count==0 — both branches correctly tested.

push_service.send_push() opt-out filter is implemented as a batch lookup with $in (one query, not N+1) and uses fail-open on exception (logged warning, send proceeds) — sensible for waitlist-criticality. Filter correctly returns False without calling provider when post-filter recipients is empty.

_audit() upserts $set notifications_enabled=True AND $unset disabled_at on every successful register — this implements the opt-in-implicit-on-re-register design exactly as spec'd in the review_request. Verified end-to-end.
Idempotency confirmed at both endpoint (2x disable-push) and DB layer (1 doc after multiple calls, updated_at refreshed each time).

Frontend files (/app/frontend/app/configuracion/notificaciones.tsx, usePushRegistration.ts, src/api.ts, mi-cuenta.tsx) NOT executed per review_request.testing_type='backend only' and the agent-to-agent note explicitly excluding Expo Switch UI from web-preview validation (requires native build).
